# ngx-drag-resize documentation

> The Angular library provides drag-and-resize UI interactions

> Generated by compodoc 2.0.0 at 2026-08-26T12:21:14.945Z, llm-md export.

## Directives

### NgxDragDirective

File: `src/lib/drag/drag.directive.ts`
Selector: `[ngxDrag]`

Description: The directive that allows to drag HTML element on page Dmytro Parfenov dmitryparfenov937@gmail.com See https://angular.io/guide/angular-compiler-options#strictmetadataemit

Inputs:
- `ngxDragBoundary: string | HTMLElement` — Constrain for the dragging element. Can be as a HTMLElement or CSS selector. You can put 'window' string to define window object as a constraint.
- `ngxDragDisabled: boolean = false` — Disable any drag events
- `ngxDragLockAxis: Axis = null` — Locks axis for the dragging
- `ngxDragPositionStrategy: PositionStrategy = 'free'` — Define positioning strategy. 'free' - position will change by 'transform: translate3d()' style See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/transform-function/translate3d 'relative' - position will change by 'top' and 'left' style See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/position Default is 'free'.

Outputs:
- `ngxDragged: EventEmitter = new EventEmitter<NgxDrag>()` — Emits changes when element was dragged

Methods:
- `observe(target: unknown = this.elementRef.nativeElement): void` — Observe the element dragging which will be as handle for dragging

### NgxDragHandleDirective

File: `src/lib/drag/drag-handle.directive.ts`
Selector: `[ngxDragHandle]`

Description: The directive that allows to mark HTML element as handle of dragging element for NgxDragDirective Dmytro Parfenov dmitryparfenov937@gmail.com See https://angular.io/guide/angular-compiler-options#strictmetadataemit

### NgxResizeDirective

File: `src/lib/resize/resize.directive.ts`
Selector: `[ngxResize]`

Description: The directive that allows to resize HTML element on page Dmytro Parfenov dmitryparfenov937@gmail.com See https://angular.io/guide/angular-compiler-options#strictmetadataemit

Inputs:
- `ngxResizeAspectRatio: number = 0` — Aspect ratio the element will use during resize Example : 16/9 - 9/16 \* 100 = 56.25 1/1 - 1/1 \* 100 = 100
- `ngxResizeBoundary: string | HTMLElement` — Constrain of the resizing area. Can be as a HTMLElement or CSS selector. You can put 'window' string to define window object as a constraint.
- `ngxResizeDisabled: boolean = false` — Disables any resize events
- `ngxResizeLockAxis: Axis = null` — Locks axis for the resize
- `ngxResizeMinHeight: number = 0` — Minimal height in px
- `ngxResizeMinWidth: number = 0` — Minimal width in px
- `ngxResizePosition: PositionType = 'absolute'` — Position CSS style. Allows 'absolute' and 'fixed'. Default is 'absolute'. Will be applied to host element. See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/position
- `ngxResizeTouchesDisabled: boolean` — Disables resize by touches. By default, is 'false'. Resizing works by using two fingers.
- `ngxResizeWheelDisabled: boolean` — Disables resize by wheel. By default, is 'false'.
- `ngxResizeWheelInitiatorRegExp: RegExp | string` — A regular expression that matches with keyboard key code. When value is provided the element can be scaled by 'Key + wheel'. If value not provided the element can be scaled just by 'wheel'. See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/KeyboardEvent/code
- `ngxResizeWheelInverse: boolean = false` — Enables inversion for wheel event

Outputs:
- `ngxResized: EventEmitter = new EventEmitter<NgxResize>()` — Emits changes when element was resized

Properties:
- `elementRef: unknown = inject<ElementRef<HTMLElement>>(ElementRef)`

Methods:
- `observe(target: HTMLElement): void` — Observe the element dragging which will be as handle for resize
- `unsubscribe(target: HTMLElement): void` — Unsubscribe from the element dragging and remove it from an array of observable objects

### NgxResizeHandleDirective

File: `src/lib/resize/resize-handle.directive.ts`
Selector: `[ngxResizeHandle]`

Description: The directive that allows to mark HTML element as one of handle of resizing element for NgxResizeDirective Dmytro Parfenov dmitryparfenov937@gmail.com See https://angular.io/guide/angular-compiler-options#strictmetadataemit

Inputs:
- `ngxResizeHandle: NgxResizeHandleType | null = null` — Sets the attribute which define the side the HTML element will affect during drag

## Public type aliases

- `type Axis = "x" | "y" | null`
- `type MovementNative = MouseEvent | TouchEvent`

- `type PositionType = "fixed" | "absolute"`

## Public enumerations

- `enum NgxResizeHandleType`
  - `TopLeft = top-left`
  - `Top = top`
  - `TopRight = top-right`
  - `Right = right`
  - `BottomRight = bottom-right`
  - `Bottom = bottom`
  - `BottomLeft = bottom-left`
  - `Left = left`
